shows.title: Grey's Anatomy
shows.overview: The doctors face life-or-death decisions daily.

shows.title: 100 Days of Deception
shows.overview: Set in 1930s Joseon, this period romance follows a pickpocket-turned-spy who infiltrates enemy territory — only to fall for the son of her main target.

shows.title: Best Medicine
shows.overview: A blunt yet brilliant surgeon becomes the general practitioner in a quaint fishing village.

shows.title: The Apothecary Diaries
shows.overview: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

shows.title: Doc
shows.overview: A doctor with memory loss must navigate an unfamiliar world.

shows.title: Raw
shows.overview: WWE's groundbreaking in-ring series highlights over three decades of unforgettable matches, moments and Superstar-studded episodes.

shows.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
shows.overview: Welcome to Night City, a dystopian future where corrupt businessmen and cybernetically enhanced humans thrive — the rest are left to claw their way up.

shows.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
shows.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

shows.title: Animal Control
shows.overview: Animal Control follows a group of Animal Control workers whose lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not.

shows.title: Fire Country
shows.overview: FIRE COUNTRY stars "SEAL Team" alum Max Thieriot as Bode Donovan, a young convict who joins a firefighting program that returns him to his small Northern California hometown, where he and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region. The show is inspired by Thieriot's experiences growing up in northern California fire country.

shows.title: Tougen Anki
shows.overview: After his father is murdered, a rebellious teen discovers his Oni ancestry and enters an academy to hone his powers in the secret demon-hero war.

shows.title: Blue Box
shows.overview: This uplifting anime about the budding romance between a rookie badminton player and a basketball star is based on the award-winning manga by Kouji Miura.

shows.title: Where the Mask Ends
shows.overview: Under imperial rule, a substitute bride in a forced marriage fights to survive clan and court schemes without exposing her identity.

shows.title: The Diplomat
shows.overview: US diplomat Kate Wyler negotiates political and marital crises in this Emmy-winning drama starring Keri Russell, Rufus Sewell and Allison Janney.

shows.title: Law & Order
shows.overview: Delves into the relationships between detectives and prosecutors in New York as they attempt to weigh the guilt or innocence of suspects while investigating complex cases.

shows.title: Ranma1/2
shows.overview: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

shows.title: Love Is Blind
shows.overview: Flirting. Falling. And finding their way to the altar? Anything is possible in this reality experience that inspires singles seeking love to look beyond superficiality and connect with each other, one life-changing decision at a time.

shows.title: North of North
shows.overview: When she finds herself suddenly single, a young mom decides to live on her own terms in this irreverent comedy series, set in a small Inuit community in the Canadian Arctic.

shows.title: The Ramparts of Ice
shows.overview: Weighed down by memories she can’t shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

shows.title: Detective Conan
shows.overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Shinichi Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.
